segments.text:
In 1941, the Soviet Union looked finished.

When Germany launched Operation Barbarossa, the Red Army was hit with one of the most devastating military disasters in history.
segments.image_title: File:Axis invasion of Soviet Union, June-December 1941 with surrounded Soviet Armies.svg

segments.text: Entire Soviet armies were surrounded. Hundreds of thousands of soldiers were captured. Thousands of tanks and aircraft were destroyed in the opening months.
segments.image_title: File:Captured Soviet prisoners of war used for working duty 1941 Finland.jpeg
segments.license_note: Public domain per Wikimedia Commons (Heikki Roivainen). No attribution required. Source page: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Captured_Soviet_prisoners_of_war_used_for_working_duty_1941_Finland.jpeg

segments.text: By autumn, German forces had taken vast territories, including much of Ukraine and Belarus.
